top_signals.title: What Happens to Tribal Knowledge When Dispatchers Retire?
top_signals.summary:
As veteran dispatchers and ops managers age out of the workforce, small and mid-size freight operators are stuck running decades-old systems that never got the AI investment enterprise carriers did. Evos, an autonomous operation launching this fall, says it can capture that institutional knowledge and put it to work before it walks out the door.

The post What Happens to Tribal Knowledge When Dispatchers Retire? appeared first on FreightWaves.
